1._section_summary: This study investigated the psychometric properties of the Polish version of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) using data from 721 Polish individuals across two subsamples (n = 336, M age = 34.95; n = 385, M age = 35.38). Confirmatory factor analyses supported the one-dimensional structure of BAS-2, and full scalar invariance across sex was demonstrated. The Polish BAS-2 showed adequate internal consistency and convergent validity through significant correlations with body image variables, well-being measures, and body mass index.
